# Monochrome

Greyscale, classic sepia, or a duotone that maps shadows and highlights to two colors.

<EffectDemo effect="monochrome" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { monochrome } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/monochrome';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(monochrome({ preset: 'noir' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'grayscale'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                          | Default       | Range | Description                                   |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`       | 'grayscale' \| 'sepia' \| 'duotone'                           | `'grayscale'` |       | The kind of toning.                           |
| `amount`     | number                                                        | `1`           | 0 – 1 | Mix between the original and the toned image. |
| `shadows`    | hex color (theme: [`background`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#1b1f3b'`   |       | Duotone: the color of the darkest areas.      |
| `highlights` | hex color (theme: [`text`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles))       | `'#ffd59e'`   |       | Duotone: the color of the brightest areas.    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                                         |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `noir`   | `mode: 'grayscale'`                                              |
| `sepia`  | `mode: 'sepia'`                                                  |
| `ocean`  | `mode: 'duotone'`, `shadows: '#0b1d3a'`, `highlights: '#7fe7ff'` |
| `sunset` | `mode: 'duotone'`, `shadows: '#2b0f3a'`, `highlights: '#ffb36b'` |

Apply one with `monochrome({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 7.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/monochrome`, including the shared effect runtime.
